component.name: KitVR
component.summary: Stream a PC desktop or SteamVR to a Quest headset

description.p: KitVR streams a Windows or Linux PC to a Quest 2, 3, or 3S over the local network, in the spirit of Virtual Desktop.
On Linux it also captures SteamVR by loading a Vulkan layer into vrcompositor, because SteamVR for Linux does not hand frames to OpenVR drivers.
